_doc: Poses of the big parts only (absolute KiCad x, y in mm and rotation in degrees, as groundup placement.json). 'pose' = typed (taken from tools/battery-bank/groundup/placement.json); 'translate' = derived by place_generic.py: the pose of the port-1 twin shifted by the offset between a pair of FIXED parts (here L401 -> L501), no number typed. Which parts are anchors is a rule in place_generic.py (ICs, inductors, fuses, shunts, kelvin sense resistors, FETs and diodes with 8 or more pads); this file must hold a pose or a derivation for each. Variant: the port top-block anchors (U401, U402, U501, U502, R424, R524, D401) take the rebuild worker v5 poses.

U401.why: port 1 PD controller (pose from team A rebuild v5)

U402.why: port 1 EEPROM (pose from team A rebuild v5)

U501.why: port 2 PD controller (pose from team A rebuild v5)

U502.why: port 2 EEPROM (pose from team A rebuild v5)

U503.why: port 2 charger stage = port 1 stage translated by the fixed inductor pair

Q501.why: port 2 charger stage = port 1 stage translated by the fixed inductor pair

Q502.why: port 2 charger stage = port 1 stage translated by the fixed inductor pair

R424.why: port 1 RAC sense resistor (pose from team A rebuild v5)

R524.why: port 2 RAC sense resistor (pose from team A rebuild v5)

R527.why: port 2 charger stage = port 1 stage translated by the fixed inductor pair

D401.why: port 1 VBUS TVS (pose from team A rebuild v5)
